title: Mendocino College Ceramics Courses (Gas Reduction Kilns)
source_quote: The ceramic studio incorporates 18 wheels, 5 electric and 4 gas reduction kilns, 1 raku and saggar, and a soda kiln with a dedicated teaching team.
evidence_sentence: The ceramics department operates 4 gas reduction kilns as part of its studio equipment.
